C-CI-CLOSURE-EVIDENCE.IntentSummary: Implement the accepted CI evidence protocol in isolation, then review.

T-001.Title: Issue and independently verify bounded prior evidence with read-only API access

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Prior proof from trusted successful job, exact normalized content, and fresh successful current jobs required together.

T-002.Title: Exercise positive and negative controls and independent audit

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Isolated validation, preserve findings and activation gaps.
